# What Mum wants me to remember

Mum said the spare key should stay with her neighbour, not with me. I had written a very tidy emergency plan without asking who she wanted to call. Revised [[Care arrangements]] to distinguish her choices from my tasks. The pharmacy can prepare the packets, but she wants to collect them herself. We should review this after the next appointment, rather than gradually treating every exception as a permanent arrangement.
